text:
lina: FYI i'm onboarding honeycomb-mini w/ int6-perchannel on staging. initial short-tail recall regression, looking into fixes.

sanjay: can you summarise metrics quickly?

lina: baseline float16 r@1 0.61 r@5 0.83 silhouette 0.20. int6-perchannel r@1 0.57 r@5 0.80 silhouette 0.14. odd thing: non-en short queries (es, fr) look relatively unaffected, but en short queries collapsed.

otto: did you run anchor calibration?

lina: ran global calibration only. per-bucket norms show <=5-token en queries norm drop ~22%. multilingual buckets stable.

mika: suggests tokenization/regional piece affecting norm distribution. maybe tokenizer pads or merges differently. try per-language bucket calibration + per-channel scaling.

sanjay: also check batch vs single encode differences (batching can affect numeric path for quant).

lina: good point. single-encode vs batched gave small differences (~1-2% norm) but not enough.

mika: plan: (A) per-language + per-length calibration on 5k anchor, (B) re-fit whitening after quant, (C) run 50k holdout sweep and multilingual parity. success: r@1 >=0.585 and silhouette >=0.18.

qa-bot: scheduled job anchor-calib-5k-honeycomb-int6 at 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z (job id: jb-9987).

lina: quick run A done: r@1 0.588 r@5 0.82 silhouette 0.179. english short-gap reduced to 4%. attaching regressions list: /staging/artifacts/honeycomb/int6/lang-bucket/regressions.csv

sanjay: that's within threshold if stable on holdout. run B and full sweep, then canary with monitoring for entity/paraphrase failures.

lina: kicking off B + 50k holdout. will post results and open PR to add language-length anchor calibration to quant pipeline.

mika: please add a small CI test that compares pre/post quant short-bucket norm shifts and fails if >10%. prevents silent regressions.

lina: will add test + PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/534 (WIP). tagging y'all when holdout completes. :memo:
